                          How the ranks are made. Every word here carries a hundred numbers, blended from two models: GloVe, which read six billion words of Wikipedia and newswire and learned what keeps company with what, and counter-fitted vectors, tuned so that words meaning the same thing sit together while merely-related ones drift apart. Two words are scored by the angle between them, then all fifty thousand are sorted against the target. Rank 1 is the word itself.

                          The whole model runs in this page. Nothing is sent anywhere, and it works with no connection.
